exceptions.behavior: When the travel-date set changes, existing operational boat and van assignments are deliberately cleared; a charter boat assignment is retained.
Cancelled, rejected, cancelled_weather, and pending approvals caused by over-capacity do not consume seat inventory. Charter-mode trips do not consume the seat pool.
A child/sub-lock contributes zero directly to the sellable-pool hold because its parent already holds the allocation.
A charter boat is excluded from the seat-boat picker whether it is marked in Boat Operation or is only discoverable from a non-cancelled charter booking.
Legacy flat longtail pricing is intentionally spread to every applicable route; a route-specific entry wins when present.
